thread:
alex: Quick heads-up: spike of structured-tool rejects on /internal/billing (~6% in last 30m). Validator points to schema mismatch at /meta — clients are sending an array instead of an object. sample below.

maria: Can you paste the raw payload and which model/variant? Also link to the dashboard pls.

alex: pasted sample payload: 
```json
{
  "transaction_id": "txn_123",
  "amount_cents": 1200,
  "meta": [
    {"key": "region", "value": "us-west"}
  ]
}
```

deploy-bot: Deploy 1768502400 completed canary to svc/internal-billing (image:billing:0.9.3) :white_check_mark:

sam: That aligns — canary rolled at ~15:04 UTC. If the client library bumped serialization, we could inadvertently accept array. Our schema expects `meta` to be object|null.

jin: Telemetry note: we currently tag these as `fncall_schema_mismatch` but sample rate for payloads is 0.01 so we don't get many raw examples. We should add breadcrumb fields (route_id, client_id, model_variant) into validator telemetry to map back to the customer. Also consider a lightweight header (X-RW-BREAD) that gets captured into traces.

lena: UX ask: in Console validator alerts show a collapsed "recent sample" with redaction and a header row for request metadata. Also a one-click sampling toggle so SRE/product can flip higher capture for a route.

maria: Short-term mitigation: can we bump sampling to 1% for /internal/billing and enable capture? Alex — can you open a ticket and enable permissive fallback for 24h so customers aren't blocked?

alex: Created RW-4321 (linked in ticketing). I toggled permissive fallback for /internal/billing -> fallback transformer for 24h and increased sampling to 1%. Monitoring alerts set to 3m granularity.

sam: If this is client-side, add a lint/regression test to guard meta's type. I'll draft a PR that asserts `meta` schema in integration tests.

jin: Also: ask metrics team to add a histogram `validator.rejects_by_schema_path` and expose top-10 rejecting paths on the validators dashboard. That will help prioritize.

alex: Thanks everyone. We'll watch RW-4321 and update here. If anyone sees a correlated spike in quota or routing fallbacks, call it out.

maria: cc @lena for console tweaks and @jin for telemetry follow-ups. :point_up:
